reported_status: Separate companion theorem reported by the source: for an exact EXTREME CPTP channel with an initially uncorrelated finite mixed bath, the whole physical bath output has B(rho)=W[C(rho) tensor tau]W^dagger. Local CPTP output processing therefore recovers the complete minimal complement without the bath purifier. The normal form forces r rank(tau)<=dim E_out and certifies, rather than creates, pure virtual resources. Given actual B and a right inverse of C, a positively regularized whole-bath decoder has exact success at least 1-D lambda and deterministic error at most 2D lambda. This whole-bath decoder is NOT automatically causal, no thermal-input causal reception is proved, and ambiguous DOM coefficients are not reconstructed.
